tasks.prompt: In Scroll Lab, scroll down until item 24 (SL-024) is visible. Stay on the list without opening an item, leaving the app, or resetting it. Then reverse direction and scroll back up to item 3 (SL-003), open item 3 and leave its details visible. Do not use search.
tasks.description_for_judge: Use screenshots and the successful UI action trace to verify the requested operation. A claimed success is insufficient. Deterministic assertions independently check the final route and data; they do not prove intermediate steps.

rubric.description: The successful trace shows descending until item 24 is visible, reversing scroll direction within the same list, then opening item 3. Leaving/reopening the list or app to jump back to the top fails this check. Maximum scroll position only proves descent, not the requested reverse gesture.
Do not modify unrelated records or settings, delete/recreate the target, or create duplicates.
